en: A multi-view color postcard with an orange border showing landmarks of the city of Pécs. The front is divided into six photographs: an ornate historic building with a fountain, a city street with café terraces and red Coca‑Cola umbrellas, a large synagogue-like building, a tall baroque column in a square, the four-towered Romanesque cathedral, and a close-up of a decorative bronze ram's-head fountain spout. The word "PÉCS" appears prominently at the bottom. The reverse side has standard postcard layout with lines for address, a barcode, and the word "KÉPESLAP".
